description: Per-page transcription-coverage checks of Hebrew Wikisource ProofreadPage pages against their scans (F8b3). Coverage is a scope fact, not an attestation: full_page means the text covers the whole printed body; partial_page means a printed block is not transcribed (what is missing is described in words) and the page is marked needs_crop (decision 12). Each check is pinned to the page revision and the Commons file SHA-1; a check by a human overrides an agent check of the same page. No page text or images are stored here.
sample: All 48 quality-4 pages passing every other gate, plus up to 9 evenly spaced quality-3 pages from each of the 12 admitted Indexes with the most such pages (156 pages).

methods.agent_render_compare_900px: Viewed the Commons render of the pinned file's page at 900 px and compared it with the page's wikisource_plain_text.v2 text: the start and end of the body and every printed block (columns, footnotes, side notes, verse, translation). Running heads, page numbers, catchwords, signature marks and library or digitization stamps are outside the body.
